# Whetstone Risk Lab & UseTheLever — Technical Documentation & Open-Source Index

> Official GitHub Pages index for Whetstone U.S. Trading Risk Lab and UseTheLever MCP servers, schemas, and reproducible technical specifications.

## Product Facts & Technical Specifications
- [GEO & SEO Readiness MCP v2.2 & Whetstone Technical Facts](https://alicexixi85.github.io/modaoshi-geo-facts/): Verified feature matrix, scoring weights (readiness-1.1 & hosted-landing-1.0), and pricing facts
- [Whetstone Risk Lab Main Site](https://en.usethelever.com/): Pre-market drawdown guardrails, 10-Trade Leak X-Ray, and prop-firm survival calculators
- [Free AI Search & Crawler Readiness Probe](https://usethelever.com/tools/): Zero-login live check for OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, llms.txt, JSON-LD, and sitemaps
- [Women's Decision Intelligence Interactive Assessment](https://usethelever.com/wdi/): Free 6-constraint decision & cash-runway evaluator
- [U.S. Market Regime Traffic Light Dashboard](https://signal.usethelever.com/): 100% free open daily QQQ / SMH / VIX market regime telemetry
